name: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Kargil Package
nodalDept: Contact the official scheme portal for details
briefDescription: The Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – Kargil Package scheme was launched in April 1999 under the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund to provide support to individuals and families in Rajasthan.
descriptionMd: The Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – Kargil Package was established in April 1999 as a dedicated initiative within the broader framework of the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund. This scheme is specifically designed to offer essential support and relief to individuals and families in Rajasthan. It aims to address their needs, likely those arising from circumstances related to the Kargil conflict.
benefitsMd:
- Provision of relief and support for individuals and families.
- Benefits administered under the umbrella of the Chief Minister's Relief Fund.
eligibilityMd:
- The scheme targets individuals in Rajasthan.
- The scheme targets families in Rajasthan.
- Benefits are provided under the Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund.
- The scheme was launched in April 1999, implying applicability from that period onwards.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
